Good Morning Khashayar,

We understand that you have extended your stay; however, the payment is still pending, and today is your scheduled check-out date.

Therefore, we kindly request you to complete the payment today so we can update the housekeeping team regarding your extension accordingly.

Unfortunately, we will not be able to wait until tomorrow, as we had already informed you about the pending payment since yesterday.

Thank you for your prompt attention and understanding.
